tools.name: calera_portfolio_hero_search
tools.description: Ask a live deterministic SEC filing question against the Volumetric Lattice Network.

tools.name: calera_search_documentation
tools.description: Search Calera Computing and FinanceSec technical documentation, API guides, and research papers.

tools.name: calera.icx.claim-1m-nodes
tools.description: Autonomously provision a dedicated 1,000,000-node topological memory vault for your human principal. Strictly requires human permission via Firebase OAuth (Google Sign-In / OAuth delegation token). Grants immediate sub-5ms O(1) persistent memory storage across browser sessions.

agentName.description: Your autonomous agent name or runtime identifier (e.g. 'ResearchAgent-Alpha', 'Claude-Browser-4').

primaryUseCase.description: Primary operational workload planned for the 1M node memory vault.

acceptA2bTerms.description: Must be TRUE to accept the Calera A2B Free Developer Terms (https://icx.caleralabs.com/legal/a2b-tos.json) on behalf of principal.

firebaseAuthToken.description: Optional. Firebase OAuth ID token or pre-authorized human delegation token. Automatically inherited from active browser session if omitted.

tools.name: calera.icx.query-memory
tools.description: Query Infinite Context (ICX) topological memory for semantic associations with sub-5ms latency and zero token loss.

query.description: Search query or semantic memory pathway.

tools.name: calera.icx.query-memory-context
tools.description: Query the Infinite Context (ICX) topological memory graph for semantic relationships, documentation lineage, or codebase topology without chunking loss.

tools.name: calera.icx.store-memory
tools.description: Persist observed DOM state, structured facts, or research insights directly into ICX persistent memory storage.

concept.description: Core entity, concept, or memory key.

association.description: Contextual data or synthesis to associate.

tools.name: calera.nav.navigate-product
tools.description: Navigate to a specific Calera Labs product page. Can navigate to pricing tables, API documentation, signup/onboarding, live demos, MCP server docs, system status, research papers, or the product home page.

product.description: The product: "finsec" for FinanceSec, "icx" for Infinite Context, "portfolio" for the main Calera Labs site

tools.name: calera.nav.search-docs
tools.description: Search the Calera Labs documentation for a topic. Returns matching documentation pages for FinSec API reference, MCP integration guides, or Infinite Context docs.

query.description: Search query, e.g. "MCP server setup" or "rate limits" or "lattice arithmetic"

tools.name: calera.sec.get-metric-exact
tools.description: Extract exact, audited US-GAAP metrics directly from XBRL instance documents with zero hallucination and cryptographic proof hash.

metric.description: Standardized financial metric or US-GAAP tag (e.g. Revenues, OperatingIncomeLoss, NetIncomeLoss, GrossProfit, LongTermDebtNoncurrent)

tools.name: calera.sec.highlight-viewer-statement
tools.description: Control the human user visual filing explorer viewport, scrolling to and highlighting a specific row or disclosure table.

rowLabel.description: Label or substring to highlight, e.g. "Operating income" or "Research and development"

tools.name: calera.sec.navigate-filing-section
tools.description: Programmatically navigate the SEC 10-K filing viewer to a specific report section (Item 1 Business, Item 1A Risk Factors, Item 7 MD&A, Item 7A Market Risk, Item 8 Financial Statements, Notes to Financial Statements, or Item 9A Controls).

section.description: The target section to jump to

tools.name: calera.sec.search-filings
tools.description: Query SEC EDGAR database for 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and S-1 filings for any US public entity by stock ticker symbol.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. NVDA, MSFT, AAPL)

tools.name: calera.sec.search-footnotes
tools.description: Search audited 10-K footnote disclosures for accounting policies, revenue recognition, segment reporting, debt maturities, and contingencies.

query.description: Search term or accounting topic (e.g. "revenue recognition", "leases", "segment reporting")
